title: Typestate pattern for RouteDiscovery prevents invalid state transitions
description:
Location: rust/lichen-core/src/loadng.rs lines 193-358

What is good: The RouteDiscovery<S> typestate pattern enforces valid state machine transitions at compile time:
- Idle -> Searching (start)
- Searching -> Searching | Replied | Failed (advance_ring, receive_rrep, fail)
- Replied/Failed -> (terminal)

This eliminates an entire class of runtime bugs where code attempts invalid transitions. The pattern is correctly implemented with PhantomData markers and type-safe transition methods.

Additionally, receive_rrep (line 338) enforces signature presence for RREPs, preventing route injection attacks at the API level - the right layer to enforce this invariant.

Worth defending if someone suggests simplifying to runtime enum state.
